events.text: Circa: The Ice Age ends with the great ocean receding to reveal Merrouroboros.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 5

events.text: Circa: Most of the modern races do not inhabit Abeir-Toril. One of the few exceptions is humanity. They are said to exist as primitive, apelike creatures that live in caves and only use simple tools. Some modern scholars dispute this characterization.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 5
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: The creator races dominate Faerûn.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 5

events.text: Circa: This is the beginning of recorded history, and marks the beginning of the Days of Thunder.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 5

events.text: Circa: The sarrukh empires begin to rise.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 5

events.text: Circa: The sarrukh realm of Okoth is established south of what will one day be known as Mulhorand. The sarrukh control most of Faerûn in a century.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 5

events.text: Circa: The realm of Mhairshaulk is founded in what will one day be known as the Chultan Peninsula by the Sarrukh, a creator race. The Mhairshaulkans begin creating the nagas, yuan-ti, troglodytes, pterafolk and other, later extinct races.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 5

events.text: Circa: The realm of Isstosseffifil is founded by sarrukh in the latter-day Anauroch.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 5

events.text: Circa: The Okoth Empire collapses after a century of civil strife. Many Okoth sarrukh flee to the planes.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 7

events.text: Circa: The plane of Faerie is ruled by the fey. They begin to create korreds, pixies, and sprites.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 7

events.text: Circa: The Ba'etith, a sarrukh organization dedicated the primitive forms of magic used by other races, is formed.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 7

events.text: Circa: Wizards of Isstosseffifil magically reroute the Narrow Sea to run east–west and flood the Phaerlin (later the Buried Realms) and destroy the phaerimms. They succeed, and the phaerimms are driven further underground. However, the Isstosseff also flood the land around the Tagorlar hills, and the ecological catastrophe leads to the collapse of the Isstosseffifil empire.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 7–8

events.text: Circa: The sarrukh-ruled realm of Mhairshaulk falls into gradual decline and somnolence. The yuan-ti come to dominate.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: The Batrachi Empires, of the batrachi creator race, rise to prominence.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: The Batrachi Empires reach their peak under Zhoukoudien's rule, before he is in killed in battle by the titan thane Omo.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: The Tearfall: Abeir-Toril suffers a planet-wide disaster. According to later speculation, a comet or ice moon struck the planet, while ancient sarrukh writings mention a "changing of the stars". The land suffers earthquakes, fires, and windstorms, and the continents and seas are reshaped. The four Inner Seas combined into the Sea of Fallen Stars, and there is radical climate change.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: The batrachi civilization is destroyed by the radical climate change caused by the Tearfall.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: The aearee rise to power and establish several empires across Faerûn. The Aearee-Krocaa found Viakoo on Mount Havraquoar in the west, the Aearee-Syran found Phwiukree in the Star Mounts in the north, and the Aearee-Quor found Shara in the Orsraun Mountains.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: Following the Tearfall, dragon eggs hatch in their tens of thousands all over Abeir-Toril.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: A number of lammasu defeat a much larger force of Aearee-Krocaa, killing one thousand. The aearee later experiment on domesticated landwyrms to create winged wyrms, or wyverns. Supported by wyvern forces, the Aearee-Krocaa empire commence a rapid expansion.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: The gnolls of Urgnarash battle the aearee of Kookrui-Shara. Gnoll shamans, following Yeenoghu, summon marrashi to spread disease among the aearee. Aearee crops are blighted, and the aearee suffer the Wasting Plague. The Aearee-Quor are decimated, and many of them begin worshiping the demon lord Pazrael to seek salvation.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: Dragons all over Faerûn gather in the first Flight of Dragons to assault the aearee in the sky, on land, and underground. The Aearee Empires fall, as Viakoo is burned from the air, and Shara is conquered by the dragon-general Nagamat. This begins the Time of Dragons.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: Draconic religious factions begin to fight over their different philosophies. The most violent conflicts are those fought among the followers of Asgorath.
cites: Dragons of Faerûn, с. 7
Draconomicon (1990), с. 29

events.text: Circa: The start of the War of the Seldarine as the goddess Araushnee, later known as the demon-goddess Lolth, is banished to the Demonweb Pits. Vhaeraun, his mother's accomplice, is simply exiled from Arvandor. Eilistraee foresees times of hardships for her people, the dark elves; in order to be with them when they would need her the most, and to provide them a beacon of hope, she chooses to share her mother's and brother's punishment despite being cleared from any guilt. Malkizid, a solar, receives a brand for his actions and is exiled to the Nine Hells.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 51
Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 67

events.text: Circa: Annam All-Father, god of the giants, and Othea, a lesser demigoddess of Abeir-Toril marry and have eight terrestrial children. Annam founds Ostoria in their honor. This marks the beginning of the Time of Giants.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: As dragons and giants rule nearly all of Faerûn, they begin to fight over territory, leading to great battles between giant nations such as Darchar, Grunfesting, Helligheim, Nedeheim, Ostoria, and Rangfjell, and dragon-ruled realms such as Argissthilliax, Caesinmalsvir, Darastriverthicha, and Tharkrixghontix.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8
Giantcraft

events.text: Circa: The dragon-general Nagamat is attacked and killed by followers of Xymor (Bahamut), triggering the ongoing Dragonfall War between followers of Tiamat and those of Bahamut.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: Ostoria, the giant kingdom, reaches its maximum extent, reaching from the Vilhon Reach across Faerûn to the Cold Lands.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: The Fey open gates from Faerie to Toril, allowing the first elves to cross over and settle, as part of an effort to undermine the power of the dragons. The green elves continue to live contentedly as small, scattered tribes, and they worship the Faerie gods (rather than the then-unknown Seldarine). However, one tribe, the Ilythiiri, negotiates with the dragons and establishes a small southern kingdom based around their capital, Atorrnash, which stands as a glorious example of elven culture for millennia to come.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: Led by avatar of the dragon god Garyx, red dragons assault the giants of Ostoria, triggering the Thousand Year War as the rest of dragonkind gets involved as well.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: Othea, wife of Annam and goddess and mother of giants, has affairs with several other deities, including Vaprak, god of ogres. But she is left unsatisfied.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: The affair of Othea and Ulutiu begins. It will eventually produce four sons: firbolg, verbeeg, voadkyn, and fomorian.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: Gold elf refugees of the fall of Tintageer in the world of Faerie come to Toril through a magical portal. Led by Prince Durothil, they settle on a continent they name Faerûn, meaning "the One Land". They mix with the existing green elves and the gold elves become known as sun elves, while the descendants of the lone silver elf, Sharlario Moonflower, give rise to the moon elves.
cites: Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 93–96
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: The gold elf priestess Bonnalurie dies to open the gate to Toril and allow the elven refugees of Tintageer through.
cites: Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 93–96

events.text: Circa: The silver elf Sharlario Moonflower and his son, Cornaith, visit Atorrnash, a southern dark elf city.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: The gold elf Durothil becomes the first dragonrider as he adopts a silver dragon for his mount.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: Durothil dies battling the red dragon Mahatnartorian.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8

events.text: Circa: The Thousand Year War between dragons and giants comes to an end. Ostoria has shrunk to a fraction of its former size, on the north of the continent.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8
Giantcraft

events.text: Circa: The Dracorage mythal is created by elves from a far-northern citadel. With the coming of the King-Killer Star, it incites the First Rage of Dragons, driving dragons insane. All dragons launch into destructive rampages and battle both each other and their offspring.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8, 10

events.text: Circa: Ironfang Keep is first mentioned in ancient dragon legends dating back to this time.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 8, 10

events.text: Circa: Occidian is founded by the sun elves and Sharlarion is founded by the moon elves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: Dragons affected by a dracorage destroyed the dragon realm of Darastriverthicha.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 9

events.text: Circa: Garl Glittergold rescued the gnomes while the dragons destroyed Darastriverthicha. The god destroyed Darastrixhurthi, killing all the kobolds living there and creating the Hidden Lake.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 9

events.text: Circa: To increase change the balance of the Dragonfall War on her favor, Tiamat breeds new aberrant varieties of dragonspawn, and unleash them on the followers of Bahamut. To counter them, Bahamut creates the dragonborn to act as his soldiers and knights.
cites: Dragons of Faerûn, с. 7
Dragons of Faerûn, с. 126

events.text: Circa: Kobolds from Darastrixhurti discovered Garl Glittergold's gem caves, where the god had stored the soul-gems that containing the souls of the gnomish race. The kobolds enslaved the gnomes.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 9

events.text: Circa: Asgorath elevated Kurtulmak and Kuraulyek to godhood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 9

events.text: Circa: Kobolds and urds first appear on Faerûn, as the first dragonspawn. Is believed Kurtulmak was the first of them.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 9

events.text: Circa: Occidian is destroyed by an orc horde led by the demon Haeshkarr.
cites: Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 140–156
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: The orc horde and Haeshkarr attack Sharlarion, but are defeated by the elves.
cites: Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 140–156

events.text: Circa: Haeshkarr is slain by Kethryllia Amarillis in the Demonweb Pits.
cites: Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 140–156
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: Lolth's attention is drawn to Toril for the first time in history. She begins to seduce dark elves into worshiping her as a goddess.
cites: Evermeet: Island of Elves: MMP, с. 140–156
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: The god Ubtao summons couatls from a western continent to serve him in Chult.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: The great wyrms of the southern lands continuously assault the cities of Mhairshaulk, causing the yuan-ti realm to fall.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: Couatls and yuan-ti begin a millennium of warfare for control of Chult, eventually settling in stalemate.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: Draconic philosophers came to the conclusion that religious fighting was wasteful and that gods who allowed such behavior were not worthy of their worship. This started the dragon's apathy toward their gods, which lasted for thousands of years.
cites: Dragons of Faerûn, с. 7

events.text: Circa: Due to the effects of the Rage of Dragons, dragons were unable to take control of Faerûn again.
cites: Dragons of Faerûn, с. 8
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: The first gold elf settlements appear in Aryvandaar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: The first moon elf settlements appear in Ardeep.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Settlements of Ilythiir spread through the latter-day Shaar and Forest of Amtar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: The first gold and moon elf communities of Syòrpiir are settled.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Wild horses in the Shining Lands experience an explosion in their population numbers.
cites: theedverse: 2021-12-29 - The Shining Lands in -23,040 DR

events.text: The elven community of Illefarn is founded.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Green elves settled in Ardeep.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Moon elves settle in Orishaar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Green elves settle in Thearnytaar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Green elves settle in Eiellûr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: The elven realm of Ilythiir launches the first of an innumerable number of skirmishes against Orishaar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: Earliest evidence both of the existence and hostilities between the locathah, merfolk and sahuagin in the Sea of Fallen Stars.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Following political differences with the gold elves in Aryvandaar, green elves and dark elves begin to settle Miyeritar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Ghaunadaur is discovered by some Ilythiiri houses and worship begins in secret. Rival Ilythiiri houses find and begin worship of other evil deities, such as Lolth, in the years that follow.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 51

events.text: The Citadel of the Raven is estimated to have been built around this time, suggesting the presence of a great prehistoric human civilization.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: The great wyrm Ossavitor develops a magical means by which a dragon can attain immortality, known as Ossavitor's Way.
cites: Dragon 237: Wyrms of the North: Eldenser
Wyrms of the North: Eldenser, "The Worm Who Hides in Blades"

events.text: Retreating from strife in other elven realms and seeking simple and more peaceful lives, moon elves and green elves begin to settle Keltormir.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: Elven high mages use High Magic to create Evermeet but cause the First Sundering. The magic stretches both backward and forward in time. The continent of Faerûn is split apart, hundreds of cities are destroyed in floods, and thousands of elves are killed.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 51
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Ongoing seismic activity leads to a thousand years of earthquakes, maelstoms and other deadly oceanic phenomena, making travel and colonization of the waters exceptionally difficult.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 22

events.text: Circa: Angharradh blessed the new island of Evermeet with natural life, and Corellon wards it against Lolth, Malar and other deities the Seldarine oppose.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: Circa: Corellon grants the Tree of Souls to the elves of Evermeet.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 10

events.text: The vast majority of the sea creatures in the Black Sea are killed during the First Sundering.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 22

events.text: Circa: Elliandreth of Orishaar writes a prophecy of the Second Sundering.
cites: The Companions: Hardcover
The Godborn: Hardcover

events.text: The elven realms of Thearnytaar, Eiellûr, and Syòrpiir commence talks on unifying the elves living in the Satyrwood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Thoughts of merging into a single state are shattered as a three-sided conflict between Syòrpiir, Thearnytaar, and Eiellûr begins, known later as the War of Three Leaves. Spies and assassins from Ilythiir are responsible for creating the conflict, though this is not discovered for centuries.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 51
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Circa: Elves from Eiellûr, Syòrpiir, and Thearnytaar begin migrating to undersea realms in the Sea of Fallen Stars, and continue to do so for 7000 years.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Circa: Many elves abandoned the kingdoms of Eiellur and Syorpiir during the War of Three Leaves, settling in the Selmal Basin. This marked the beginning of the elven migrations into Seros.
cites: Sea of Fallen Stars, с. 66

events.text: The War of Three Leaves draws to a close, but the realms of Eiellûr, Syòrpiir, and Thearnytaar remain separate. They skirmish between themselves and Ilythiir for centuries.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Circa: The earliest dwarf settlements start appearing in the Yehimal mountains. Dwarves begin migrating from here into Faerûn, Kara-Tur, and Zakhara.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Circa: Fey take an interest in the archipelago formed by the First Sundering 2,600 years previous. They begin to settle the isles by way of fey crossroads.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes

events.text: Circa: Bhaerynden, the first great dwarven kingdom is founded in the cavern of the same name under the Shaar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Circa: Human tribesmen begin to wander the forest of Keltormir.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: The Second Epoch of Serôs begins when the sea elves decide to cease their aimless exploration of the Inner Sea and found the kingdom of Selmalyr in the Selmal Basin.
cites: Sea of Fallen Stars, с. 64–65

events.text: Elves from Aryvandaar start to raid into territories belonging to Miyeritar and also interfere with Miyeritar's trade routes.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Circa: The Hall of Mists beneath the High Forest is discovered by elves of Aryvandaar. They summon an elder treant to guard the location, and over thousands of years it grows into the Grandfather Tree.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Circa: Following centuries of diplomatic efforts to gain control of Miyeritar without result, the impatient and greedy rulers of Aryvandaar launch an attack on Miyeritar. They also apply political pressure on Shantel Othreier, demanding they join them or be attacked as well. This begins the first of the Crown Wars and the rise of the Vyshaantar Empire.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52

events.text: Dwarves colonize the Firepeak Mountains.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Aryvandaar annexes and occupies Miyeritar. Some clans and strongholds resist and fight the invaders. Despite Illefarn's official neutrality, many elves there secretly provide sanctuary to Miyeritari refugees.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: Coryselmal, the capital of Aryselmalyr in Serôs, is established.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Second Crown War begins. Responding to Aryvandaar's aggression, conflict grows heated once more as Ilythiir assaults any that support the northern gold elves. Orishaar, a near neighbor and major trading partner with Aryvandaar, suffers a harsh surprise attack and quickly falls.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: Dragons burn the southern reaches of Shantel Othreier, splitting off a forest later called the Wyrmwood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: Tethir, kin of Keltomir slays two red dragons single-handed, saving many elves of Keltormir and Shantel Othreier. This wins the elves some respect from the dragons.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: Clans of humans settle in the burnt sections of Keltormir, which become clearings and meadows.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: The Ilythiiri isolate Syòrpiir from its allies and destroy it with fire.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: Eiellûr and Thearnytaar ally against Ilythiir, for the Ilythiiri's practice of destruction by fire, which aggravates them more than the northern elves' bids for power. Eiellûr and Thearnytaar launch holding actions to stop the Ilythiiri from moving north.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: The balor lord Wendonai was sent by Lolth to seduce a high Ilythiiri clan into her service, and the church of Lolth began to rise in importance.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52

events.text: The Sable Wars: Aided by a few allies from Keltormir and Shantel Othreier, Eiellûr and Thearnytaar invade Ilythiir, aiming to reform or conquer the dark elves before they destroy any more realms. Over half their forces are wiped out by the dark elves' corrupt magic.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: Second Crown War: The Ilythiiri isolate Eiellûr from assistance and destroy it with fire. They are aided by treacherous green elves, who hope to restore peace by appeasing the Ilythiiri.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: The ongoing Crown Wars drives many elves to migrate to the Inner Sea, and then away from the coast and into the sea itself. This triggers the first great conflicts with merfolk and sahuagin.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12

events.text: Aryvandaar conquers Miyeritar, ending the First Crown War.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 12
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: Second Crown War: The dark elves of Ilythiir turn savage and use enslaved monsters and undead to occupy the woods of Thearnytaar. Thearnytaar falls to their forces, ending the Second Crown War. Ilythiir openly skirmishes with Keltormir along its southern and eastern borders.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 14
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: Following the fall of Thearnytar, the sea elves make another sizable migration to the sea. They expand militarily past the Selmal Basin, and begin founding Coranthys, Tor Meraliir, Ullythan Reef, and Ryeniir.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 14

events.text: The Aryselmalyr Empire is founded, controlling all the elf kingdoms in the Inner Sea. Coryselmal, grandest city of the kingdom of Selmalyr, becomes the new capital of the empire.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 14

events.text: This marks Year 1 in the Aryselmalyr Calendar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 14

events.text: Circa: Seismic and volcanic activity in Claarteeros caused by the First Sundering finally begins to subside, eventually, over the course of centuries, becoming dormant. It is thought that the leShay are responsible.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 22

events.text: Circa: Taark Shanat the Crusader and his sons lead a dwarven exodus out of Bhaerynden and into the west. They become the shield dwarves and found the empire of Shanatar. Their first holdings were in the Alimir Mountains.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 14
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 39
Calimport, с. 13

events.text: Circa: Around this time, illithid refugees from Glyth settle the enclave of Oryndoll.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 14

events.text: Circa: Leviathan arrives to guard the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 22

events.text: The Third Crown War begins when negotiations between Shantel Othreier and Aryvandaar break down and Aryvandaar attacks.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 14
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 30

events.text: The Vyshaan lords of Aryvandaar gain a secret patron in Malkizid, a fallen solar.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52

events.text: Cloaker Wars: The dwarven followers of Taark Shanat are attacked by the cloakers of Rringlor Noroth, and they fight over the caverns of Alatorin. The battle is won when Taark slays the four blue dragons who held the Rift of Dhalnadar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 14

events.text: Taark claims the dragons' lair and names it Brightaxe Hall, and creates the Wyrmskull Throne. From here, Taark forges the kingdom of Alatorin, marking the beginning of the First Great Age of Shanatar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 14

events.text: Several gold and moon elf clans of Aryvandaar and other elven realms flee the Vyshaan. They settle around latter-day Lake Miir and found Ilodhar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: Third Crown War: The Battle of the Gods' Theater is fought, one of the greatest and bloodiest battles of the Crown Wars. Over 70,000 elves die as an orc horde falls upon the battling armies of Aryvandaar and Shantel Othreier. Aryvandaar is victorious and occupies the northern half of Shantel Othreier.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 31

events.text: Third Crown War: Coronal Ynloeth dies in mysterious circumstances. Following this, Shantel Othreier is conquered by Aryvandaar ending the Third Crown War. Only the vassal realm of Ardeep holds out against the Vyshaan, though resistance movements spring up in Shantel Othreier and Miyeritar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 31

events.text: The Aelryth of Miyeritar believe Coronal Ynloeth's death to be a murder, and they launch a failed retaliatory strike against Tiru Orindraar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 14

events.text: Miyeritar suffers the Dark Disaster, and is left as a wasteland in three months. Most elves of Faerûn are left shocked and horrified, leaving a four-decade-long fearful peace amidst the Crown Wars. Though history as written by the victors says otherwise, the High Mages of Aryvandaar are responsible.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 31

events.text: Due to the Dark Disaster, the larger part of the followers of Eilistraee—a major patroness of Miyeritar—die in the cataclysm. This blow drives the goddess and her church into a near-powerless state, from which they won't recover for millennia.
cites: Demihuman Deities, с. 13

events.text: The chain of islands that would later come to be known as the Korinn Archipelago takes form in the Sea of Swords.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 24

events.text: Taark Shanat's eight sons each found their own kingdoms in the caverns beneath modern Tethyr and Amn. Following the sons' respective patron deities, each kingdom aligns itself with a particular dwarven deity.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: Circa: The kingdom of Sarifal is established with the founding of Karador on an isle in the center of Myrloch.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23

events.text: Aryvandaar conquers Ardeep. Over the next century, the Vyshaanti struggle to keep it under control, and kill two of Ardeep's rulers, Ilitharath and his grandson Tarosspur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 136

events.text: Fourth Crown War Begins: In revenge for the destruction of Miyeritar, Ilythiir counterattacks the other elven reams. They begin openly using corrupt powers, from dark and evil gods such as Ghaunadaur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 31

events.text: Guided by Wendonai, the dark elves of Clan Sethomiir of Ilythiir journey via magic to the Riildath (later the Rawlinswood and Forest of Lethyr). At a place of great evil, they construct the subterranean fortress of Narathmault (later the site of Dun-Tharos).
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: Keltormir withdraws its forces from its eastern territories and holds a defensive line at Highlands' Edge as a result of being trapped between the forces of the Vyshaan of Aryvandaar and Clan Hune of Ilythiir.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 31

events.text: The Stone and Claw Campaigns: During the Fourth Crown War, Keltormir's forces withdraw to close and defend their borders. This leaves Aryvandaar and Ilythiir facing each other in constant warfare for two centuries. Their battles are fought in the mountains (inhabited by giants) and plains (claimed by wemics) north of Keltormir.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 31

events.text: Circa: The dark elves of Ilythiir use enslaved dragons and other powers to burn Shantel Othreier. In half-a-century, over 70% of the forest is destroyed. In Illefarn and other neutral and free areas, over 1000 priests and High Mages react by spending decades in prayer to Corellon Larethian and the Seldarine, begging for salvation.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 31
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52

events.text: Shantel Othreier is destroyed by Ilythiir during the Fourth Crown War.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 52

events.text: The Fourth Crown War ends.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: The dark elves of Narathmault are similarly transformed, and this act breaks their bindings over their army of fiends. The fiends revolt, and the drow, led by Undrek of Clan Sethomiir, together with their minotaur servants, flee into the caverns beneath the Plateau of Thay.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: Corellon Larethian, acting through his priests and High Mages, magically transforms all dark elves into drow, both the corrupt Ilythiiri and others.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: Three months later, the Seldarine summon elves to the place later known as the Elven Court. There they mediate disputes and restore peace between the elven nations.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: Descent of the Drow: Within two months after the change, all drow retreat into the Underdark.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: Circa: An elder unicorn named Kamerynn arrives on the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23

events.text: Aryvandaar begins secretly persecuting High Mages and priests.
Aryvandaar annexes Illefarn and its Llewyrrwood (present-day Neverwinter Wood) colony. Illefarn is partially destroyed and elven refugees flee to what remains of Shantel Othreier.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: Assisted by Vodos the Great Builder, Serôs erects garrison towers in the Sharksteeth Mountains so that aquatic elves, merfolk, and locathath can better fight off increasingly frequent and vicious sahuagin raids.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: Work begins on the Sharksbane Wall to link the existing garrison towers in the Sharksteeth Mountains and form a barrier against sahuagin invasions. Priests of Deep Sashelas, Trishina, and Eadro manage the construction.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: The expanding empire of aquatic elves allies with the merfolk. Together, they launch the First Serôs War against the sahuagin of eastern Serôs.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: The First Serôs War ends with the fall of a major sahuagin kingdom in "Sekolah's Trench" (also called the Trench of Lopok). However, smaller wars and skirmishes continue for centuries in an effort to disrupt work on the Sharksbane Wall.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 15

events.text: The Vyshaantar Empire occupies every elven realm from Aryvandaar to Ilythiir. Vyshantaar also begins colonizing Evermeet.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Following the Crown Wars, a small population of green elves settles the Yuirwood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Fleeing oppression on the mainland, Synnoria leads a large number of elves from Llewyrr to the Moonshae Isles, where they are welcomed by the leShay of Sarifal. They find isolation and sanctuary in the mountains, and name their new home Synnoria after their queen.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16
Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23

events.text: Moon and gold elves from Shantel Othreier flee persecution by the Vyshaan of Aryvandaar. They settle the Riildath (present-day Rawlinswood and Forest of Lethyr), founding the realm of Lethyr. However, they discover Ilythiir's horrid works in Narathmault, and to protect their realm from such things, they determine to clear all non-elves from their forest.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Circa: The first Underdark drow civilizations arise in southern Faerûn, with the founding of Telantiwar and Guallidurth.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: The Elven Court delivers its First Proclamation, causing Aryvandaar's nobles to revolt and launching the Fifth Crown War. The Elven Court, priests of the Seldarine, and High Mages form pockets of resistance and freedom fighting throughout the Vyshantaar Empire. They disrupt coordination among the empire's armies and nobility, and fragment them.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Vyshaan is thoroughly defeated and Aryvandaar dissolves, ending the Fifth Crown War. Keltormir and Illefarn survive the Crown Wars whole, but Shantel Othreier no longer exists. Illefarn joins Ardeep.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Telantiwar drow conquer Bhaerynden (later the Great Rift), and occupy the dwarf city as their own.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: The eight subkingdoms of Shanatar try to expand their borders in competition with eachother. Skirmishes break out then erupt into open war, known as the Spawn Wars for the heavy use of deepspawn-bred warriors.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Dwarven refugees of Bhaerynden flee to surrounding lands. One sizable group migrates to the Chultan Peninsula, then fractures into small tribes that become the wild dwarves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Following the end of Fifth Crown War, elves begin returning to the Elven Court and the eastern forests of Cormanthor. However, the High Forest is left unoccupied for an age to regain its peace.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Circa: The Earthmother summons The Pack to the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23

events.text: The Sharksbane Wall is finished.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: The Sharksbane Wall traps the sahuagin in the south-east Inner Sea, and prevents raiders from entering Serôs. Over the next nine hundred years, the sahaugin are ruthlessly hunted and eradicated.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Taangan (later called Tuigan) tribes settle in the Endless Waste.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: The five Tunnels of Iratis in Serôs are completed before the close of the year.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: A flight of red dragons attacks the elves of forest of Keltormir, causing an out-of-control fire that burns thousands of square miles of forest. This wipes out four whole elven clans, eleven giant communities, and at least four green dragons. The surviving elves split into several clans.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Circa: Bhaerynden's Great Caverns collapse and leave the Great Rift.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: The surviving clans of Eiellûr, Miyeritar, and Orishaar secretly found the elf haven of Evereska in woodlands east of Aryvandaar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Aelinthaldaar is founded (where Waterdeep will later stand). It will be become the capital city of Illefarn.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: The forest of Keltormir, ruined by dragon fire, splits into three separate forests, the Darthiir Wood (later known as the Forest of Mir), the Forest of Tethir, and the Wyrmwood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: The First Rysar of Rystall Wood comes to an end. The First Rysar of Jhyrennstar begins with the crowning of the coronal. This marks the Year of Founding for Jhyrennstar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Circa: A small number of sun elves return to the northwestern High Forest and found Siluvanede.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Tribes of Imaskari settled in the area of the Raurin Desert, then a wide, fertile plain. This marks the beginning of the Nemrut period of Imaskar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: The Second Serôs War between the sea elf empire Aryselmalyr and the Kuo-Toan Consortiums. Aryselmalyr utilizes crabmen, merfolk and locathah forces, the latter in order to inspire the locathah slaves of the kuo-toa to rebel.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: The Second Serôs War ends with the destruction of the Kuo-Toan Consortiums by Aryselmalyr. Around the Plains of Duna (later the Haunted Plains), all of their cavern cities collapse. The kuo-toans are slaughtered, becoming practically extinct in the Sea of Fallen Stars.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Non-gold elf clans abandon Ilodhar after continuing harassment from ogres and orcs. Some of the clans migrate to Rystall Wood in the north, and the rest go to western Arcorar in the east.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 16

events.text: Uvaeren is founded and its first coronal is crowned, marking the beginning of its First Rysar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: While the dwarves of Shanatar are distracted by civil war, the drow of Guallidurth attack the kingdom of Alatorin, located far from the fighting. This begins the First Spider War as the drow capture Brightaxe Hall and Alatorin falls.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The end of the First Spider War between the dwarves of Shanatar and the drow of Guallidurth.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Following their civil war and the First Spider War, the dwarves of Shanatar make an armistice and unite against the attacking drow of Guallidurth, launching the Second Spider War. The drow are beaten and chased from Alatorin. The eight kings of Shanatar return to Brightaxe Hall and vow never to war against one another again.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The Second Spider War comes to an end as the drow are beaten and chased from Alatorin by the dwarves of Shanatar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The eight kings of Shanatar return to Brightaxe Hall and vow never to war against one another again. The eight shield dwarf tribes unite, with Ultoksamrin as their king. This begins the Second Age of Shanatar. They begin trade with elves of the surface, growing over the 150 years.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The elves of Rystall Wood found Yrlaancel, the City of Peace.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Imaskari artificers develop permanent extradimensional spaces. The magic quickly changes Imaskari architecture and urban design.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Circa: Deep Shanatar reaches its greatest size beneath the lands of southwestern Faerûn (covering latter-day Amn, Calimshan, Erlkazar, Tethyr, and the Alimir Peninsula).
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Illithids of Oryndoll assault the eastern dwarven subkingdoms of Shanatar, beginning the Mindstalker Wars. The caverns of Barakuir are cut off early in the war, and Clan Duergar is captured and enslaved by the illithids, beginning their transformation into duergar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The end of the Mindstalker Wars between the dwarves of Shanatar and the illithids of Oryndoll. As they push the illithids back, the dwarves discover that Clan Duergar has gone missing from the caverns of Barakuir.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: In Serôs, by this time all sahuagin communities west of the Sharksbane Wall have been wiped out.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Circa: Dwarves from Shanatar, cut off from their homes due to the Mindstalker Wars, find Underdark tunnels beneath the Sea of Swords which lead beneath the Moonshae Isles. In the coming years, they will establish the realm of Dwarvenhome in the caverns found under the islands.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23

events.text: The elves of Cormanthyr found Semberholme, intending it to be a safe haven for their women, children and elders during war and disaster.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 32
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The Imaskari found Inupras, the Imperial City of Imaskar, under their first emperor, Lord Artificer Umyatin. This marks the beginning of the Early Dynastic of the Imaskari.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: By this time, trade is in full swing between the dwarves of Deep Shanatar and the elves of Darthiir, Tethir, and the remaining communities of Shantel Othreier.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Imaskari forces conquer Zexthandrim.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Calim, a djinni lord, arrives in Faerûn together with his entourage of genies and their human and halfling slaves—collectively called the Djen—in the Great Arrival. Calim swiftly claims all lands south-west of the Marching Mountains as the Calim Empire, and bases his rule at Calimport.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Calimport is demolished by a Flight of Dragons, and Calim and his genies retaliate. This commences the Dragon Wars.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: A dao lord and ataman of the Great Dismal Delve on the Elemental Plane of Earth creates a portal to caverns under where the town of Kzelter in Tethyr will later stand.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Circa: Marid renegades of the Calim Empire move to Selmalyr, triggering conflict with the sea elves. The marids and their jann later move to Serôs, where they make alliances and share power with neighboring aquatic races. They give rise to the Marid States. Located deep underwater, they face no further retribution with the sea elves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The Second Rysar of Uvaeren begins.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Calim negotiates with the elves and dwarves to fix the borders of the Calim Empire, and lays claims to further lands, east to the Alimir Mountains and south to the River Agis.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The Calim Empire continues the Dragon Wars on the dragons and giants of the Marching Mountains.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: A powerful rogue marid named Ajhuu steals part of the eastern Calim Empire for himself while Calim is away fighting giants. When Calim returns, he declares war on Ajhuu's rebel faction, beginning the Steam Clashes.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 11–12, 40

events.text: Azure Falls and the Maridflow river are created with the slaying of two of Ajhuu's lieutenants Haj and Luar in the Alimir Mountains.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 11–12, 40

events.text: Unable to destroy the rebel city of Ajhuutal and witnessing the growing envy of his own people at the freedom Ajhuu's rebels enjoy, Calim rashly sacrifices his dao allies and earth magic artifacts to destroy Ajhutaal with a greatly enhanced earthquake spell. The spell's effect, later referred to as the Shattering, causes the city to crumble and fall into the sea. Unfortunately, it also destroys all the land in a thirty-mile radius around the epicenter, creating the Spider Swamp.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 12, 40

events.text: Realms of the Elves: "The Staff of Valmaxian" begins
Circa: The great cavern of Bhaerynden caves in, creating the Great Rift.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Circa: The collapse of Bhaerynden crushes the drow city of Telantiwar. Drow survivors migrate to neighboring, smaller caverns, one group founding Llurth Dreier.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Circa: Dwarves return to Bhaerynden and found the Deep Realm, where they become the gold dwarves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Elves leaving Evereska because of overcrowding and Siluvanedenn elitism. They found Sharrven in the southern High Forest.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Coronal Hoccar comes to power in Jhyrennstar, marking the beginning of its Second Rysar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: In Rystall Wood, the age of the Second Rysar ends and the Third Rysar begins.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 32

events.text: The dwarven realm of Sarphil is founded.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 32

events.text: The Imaskari destroy Zexthandrim following its rebellion.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: An orc horde topples the elven realm of Ilodhar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The coronal of Uvaeren dies while hunting. The next coronal is more militaristic and commences attacks against orcs and giants in the mountains. This marks the beginning of the Third Rysar of Uvaeren.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The Dukars rise in the town of Nantar on the Lower Hmur Plateau. At this time, they consist only of lorekeepers.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: The Taangan tribes are subjugated by the Imaskari Empire. The Imaskari demand tribute every year.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 19

events.text: Circa: Dwarves from Dwarvenhome establish Highhome in the Cambro Mountains, east of Myrloch Vale.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 24

events.text: Realms of the Elves: "The Staff of Valmaxian" ends
Turning their backs on the rest of elfkind, star elves move to the Yuirwood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The Dukars develop into a peacekeeping force for Serôs, and form the Mervae Alliance with Aryselmalyr. However, they do not need to declare their fealty to the sea elves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Coronal Kiyuigh of Uvaeren dies on a military expedition into the mountains. The Great Scholar Eltaor becomes the next coronal. This marks the Fourth Rysar of Uvaeren and a restoration of its learned reputation.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: A group of moon elves migrate from the Yuirwood to the forest of Saerdath, establishing the realm of Larlotha.
cites: Elminster in Myth Drannor, с. 118

events.text: Naevys Caersaelk becomes the first female coronal of Arcorar. This marks the end of the Third Rysar of Rystall Wood and the beginning of the Fourth.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Memnon, an efreeti, and his Army of Fire arrive in Faerûn, north of the River Agis, and found the country of Memnonnar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Forest landwyrms lay siege to the Imaskari outpost in Aerilpar, leading to the Imaskari Empire's first defeat in battle.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Imaskari peasants revolt in the city of Raudor.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The Dukars complete their four academy cities.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Border wars between the koalinth and the elf cities of Hmur Plateau and Selmal Basin come to an end.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Aryselmalyr signs a peace accord with the Marid States after some jann join the Dukars.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Peace flourishes in Serôs for some 5000 years, commencing the Golden Era of Aryselmalyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Green and star elves found Yuireshanyaar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Calim and Memnon go to war against one another. They fight twenty-two battles over four centuries, which becomes known as the First Era of Skyfire.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The Second Rysar of Jhyrennstar ends with the death of Coronal Hoccar. He is succeeded by his niece, Haalija, and the Third Rysar of Jhyrennstar begins.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Elven refugees of Syòrpiir settle in the Chondalwood. They build the city of Rucien Xan and found the nation of Nikerymath.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The beginning of the Middle Kingdoms period for the Imaskari civilization.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The city of Solon is founded by Imaskari.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Agents of the Elven Court of Cormanthor make contact with the dwarves of Sarphil in the lands later known as the Vast. Desiring to maintain control over the forests there, the Elven Court wars against the dwarves to stop them expanding to the surface. The elves later save the dwarves from being defeated by orcs, and the two sides negotiate on the Vast's battlefields. They make a tenuous alliance, but it lasts 2000 years, and each prospers from the trade of goods and information.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 26,32
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Eltaor, coronal of Uvaeren dies, ending the Fourth Rysar of Uvaeren. The younger Intevar is elected coronal, commencing the Fifth Rysar of Uvaeren.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Esyae becomes coronal of Rystall Wood, beginning the Fifth Rysar of Rystall Wood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Guallidurth drow attack the dwarves of Alatorin again, beginning the Third Spider War. They force the dwarves to abandon Brightaxe Hall, though the dwarves are able to rescue the Wyrmskull Throne.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The end of the Third Spider War between Guallidurth's drow and Alatorin's dwarves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The war between Calim and Memnon, known as the First Era of Skyfire, is ended when elves use High Magic to disembody both genie nobles. They bind the element essences of Calim to the sky and that of Memnon to the ground. The two continue to struggle against one another, forming the Calim Desert.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The Marid States are attacked by krakens while many marids and jann mysteriously vanish or die. The majority of the disappearances and deaths occur in a single year, but it continues for another sixteen years.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The Order of the Long Death is formed circa this year.
cites: Lords of Darkness, с. 166

events.text: The Marid States practically disappear. Conveniently, this removes any major rival to Aryselmalyr's domination of Serôs. The Dukars prove a moderating influence on aquatic elven rule.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Shanatar sends dwarf scouts to the surface. They ally with Calishite humans to battle genies left behind by the disembodiment of Calim and Memnon.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Assisted by Shanatar's dwarves, Calishite humans successfully rebel against the remaining genies of the broken Calim Empire.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Calishites rebuild Calimport and Keltar, and develop the nation of Coramshan.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The course of the River Agis is changed by the magic of the scepter of Calim.
cites: Star of Cursrah

events.text: Cursrah, one of the last remaining city-states of the Calim Empire, falls to the army of Oxonsis after its genie guardians and human rulers abandon it to its fate.
cites: Star of Cursrah

events.text: In eastern Coramshan, the city of Almraiven is founded.

events.text: The beginning of the Fourth Rysar of Jhyrennstar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Circa: Elves from Evereska discover the tomb of a sarrukh mummy named Hssthak. Disturbed by the danger of the sarrukh, several elves volunteer to become mummies themselves so that they can guard the tomb for the rest of time.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Circa: Humans explore the Lluirwood Forest and discover three different tribes of halfling dwelling there.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Manshaka is established in Coramshan.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The dwarves of Shanatar lay claim to lands on the surface, north of the Marching Mountains. Here they found the kingdom of High Shanatar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The Jhaamdathan Empire begins when the psychic warrior, Jhaam, unites regional human tribes under his family, the Dath Dynasty.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 114
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Jhaamdath and Coramshan begin struggling for control over the Lake of Steam area. These conflicts continue for centuries.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: Coramshan comes under the sway of the bakkals—despotic human priests of various evil gods.
cites: Empires of the Shining Seas, с. 14

events.text: Jhaamdath establishes Naarkolyth, the First City of the Sword.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 21

events.text: The psion mystic Laszik Silvermind delivers a plan for Jhaamdath's growth and development, made by Auppenser, god of psionics. Following the first commandment, Jhaamdath outlaws slavery.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Laszik Silvermind creates the first udoxias in Naarkolyth, granting psionic powers to capable beings. People of Jhaamdath gather in the city to access these powers.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Naarkolyth becomes a center of psionic education and practice. The Udoclian, a university of psionics, is founded by Laszik Silvermind.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Jhaamdath changes its oligarchic government for a psiocratic one.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Fame of the Intevar's Librarium in Uvaeren, supposedly containing all elven knowledge, grows across elven lands.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Laszik Silvermind disappears, believed by many to have ascended to serve the god Auppenser.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Avaricious elven wizards assault Intevar's Librarium and several strongholds in Uvaeren, in search of High Magic knowledge, but with no success.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Intevar suffers a poisoned wound and dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: The Fifth Rysar of Uvaeren comes to an end. Intevar is succeeded as coronal by his wife and apprentice, Lady Mnuvae. This begins the Sixth Rysar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Jhaamdath establishes Porrenath, the Second City of the Sword.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Circa: The dwarves of Shanatar break off their alliance with Coramshan due to the influence of the bakkals.
cites: Empires of the Shining Seas, с. 14

events.text: Circa: High Shanatar is at its height.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: After a High Magic ritual goes wrong, Coronal Esyae is killed.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Esyae is succeeded as coronal of Rystall Wood by her brother Mhaenal. This begins the Sixth Rysar of Rystall Wood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: The settlement of Almraiven is established.
cites: Sandstorm (novel)

events.text: Jhaamdath establishes Jhouram, the Port City, as the Third City of the Sword.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Jhaamdath's ruling psiocracy commissions its first navy.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Jhaamdath establishes Gharrent and Golmuth as the Fourth and Fifth Cities of the Sword, respectively.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Circa: Dwarves slay human tomb robbers at Mount Kellarak. The heir to the throne of Coramshan is among their number, triggering three thousand years of war between them.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Karlyn of House Kuldelver leads the dwarves of High Shanatar against the giants of Nedeheim, in the Giant Wars. Over the next sixty years, over five thousand giants—over half the giant population south of the Cloud Peaks—are wiped out and Nedeheim fragments into scattered clanholds.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 114
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: As dwarf armies are distracted by the Giant Wars, the Murabir of Coramshan capture a large part of southern High Shanatar, including Iltakar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: In response to the conflict between Coramshan and High Shanatar, Jhaamdath establishes Lirremar, the Sixth City of the Sword.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: The First Kingdom of Mir is established, lying south of the Wurlur river and west of the Darthiir Wood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Both Coramshan and Mir begin a rapid and aggressive eastward expansion, and share their captured lands.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Circa: In the city of Adofhaeranede in Siluvanede, the elves create a mythal. The city is renamed Myth Adofhaer.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Jhaamdath established the twin cities of Tuoxent and Hollinth, the Seventh and Eighth Cities of the Sword, respectively.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Circa: Dwarves of High Shanatar complete the Wailing Dwarf, a monument to Karlyn of House Kuldelver.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Dwarves establish the realm of Oghrann under the Plains of Tun.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: In Llurth Dreier, drow followers of Lolth war against those of Ghaunadaur in the Webfire Wars. This continues until -4835 DR.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: In the Mir–Jhaamdath War, Jhaamdath fights with the Kingdom of Mir and later Coramshan for control of the Lake of Steam area.
cites: Races of Faerûn, с. 85

events.text: In their first battle, north of Ankport, Jhaamdath deals a crushing defeat to Mir. Over the next twenty-five years, Jhaamdath steadily pushes Mir's forces back to Saradush.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Ukhar IV unites Coramshan and Mir as a single realm, the Calimshan Empire. They stand together against the threat from Jhaamdath.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Coramshan successfully retaliates against Jhaamdath, pushing its forces back to Saelmur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: After several decades of fighting over the Lake of Steam, Jhaamdath and Mir-Coramshan agree to a truce. Both abandon their claims to the area.
cites: Races of Faerûn, с. 85
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Coramshan and Mir unite as the Calimshan Empire under Ukhar IV, who is both bakkal and murabir.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Calimshan then claims entirety of the lands west of the Iltkazar Mountains and south of the Wurlur river.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: Circa: The dwarves of the Moonshae Isles go to war with Grond Peaksmasher's firbolgs. Grond is imprisoned in a glacier on Oman's Isle.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 24

events.text: The Twelve Nights of Fire start on Midsummer, when a meteor and its castoffs destroy the elven realm of Uvaeren and its famous libraries. The fires burn for twelve nights and ultimately sever much of the forest from the main body of Arcorar (later Cormanthor).
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 129
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 26–27
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 32–33

events.text: The fires wipe out the trees on the mountains and hills, fully dividing Rystall Wood from Arcorar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23, 26

events.text: Imaskar is struck by a devastating and suspicious plague, which then spreads east into the Hordelands.
cites: Dragon 349: The Horde: Barbarians of the Endless Waste, с. 54

events.text: Uvaeren is wiped out, with the coronal and nearly all its noble houses killed in the impact or subsequent fires. A few people flee into the deep woods of Arcorar, and few dozen survive outside Uvaeren.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23, 26

events.text: Despite Rystall Wood becoming a separate forest, its coronal remains in close contact with the leaders of the Elven Court.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23, 26

events.text: Survivors of the demon-blooded sun elves of House Dlardrageth leave Arcorar and flee to Siluvanede.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23, 26

events.text: Circa: Jhaamdathan settlers found the colony of Ankhapur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23, 26

events.text: Led by their chieftain Shemen, Raumviran tribesfolk settle the Lakelands which will eventually be known as Rashemen.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23, 26

events.text: Haunghdannar, a dwarven nation on the Sword Coast, is founded.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: House Sshamath founds the drow city of Sshamath in the Underdark beneath the Far Hills.
cites: Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark, с. 87
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23, 26

events.text: Coronal Mhaenal of Rystall Wood is slain by monsters that were summoned into his bedchambers. The subsequent murder investigation takes ninety years.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: The death of Mhaenal sees the end of the Sixth Rysar of Rystall Wood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Shemen, the chieftain of a Raumviran tribe dies. His followers name the lands they have claimed Rashemen ("lands of Shemen") and name themselves "Rashemi" in his honor..
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: The warrior Khilseith becomes coronal of Jhyrennstar, beginning the Fifth Rysar of Jhyrennstar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Circa: A blood-borne disease known as the Warrior's Plague wracks the military forces of Calimport and Almraiven.
cites: Calimport, с. 14

events.text: The ninety-year-long investigation into the murder of coronal Mhaenal of Rystall Wood ends by identifying the three nobles responsible. Two are banished from Rystall Wood and Arcorar, while the one who summoned the monsters is executed.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: After the hiatus, Injros becomes coronal, beginning the Seventh Rysar of Rystall Wood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Jhaamdath establishes Jhirrent as the Ninth City of the Sword.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: End of the Webfire Wars in Llurth Dreier.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 23

events.text: The dwarven royal house of Helm founds Gharraghaur, near what is later Mirabar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: House Dlardrageth corrupts several other powerful sun elf houses in Siluvanede. They encourage crossbreeding between elf and demon, creating the fey'ri. The fey'ri houses keep their heritage a secret, but develop great power of Siluvanede.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Circa: Calimport is wracked by the Plague of Terror. The plague induces hallucinations, and the entire waterfront burns, the result of dockworkers imagining an attack by sea monsters.
cites: Calimport, с. 14
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Circa: Seeking to limit the ambitions of nobles of Siluvanede, nobles of Sharrven found the kingdom of Eaerlann in the remnants of Aryvandaar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Jhaamdath establishes Inixrien as the Tenth City of the Sword.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Circa: The marines of Haunghdannar, known as the Sailors of the Mountainous Waves, construct the fortress of Sonnmorndin on the island of Arauwurbarak.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Elves found the tree city of Teuveamanthaar (later Tall Trees). It becomes the capital of Eaerlann.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Circa: Arcorar's High Mages locate a secret lair of House Dlardrageth beneath Ascal's Horn. They join with Eaerlanni forces to attack and kill a number of Dlardrageths. They captured Sarya Dlardrageth and her sons.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Dlardrageth-influenced noble houses of Siluvanede fight back, with skirmishes between veteran Siluvanedenn veteran forces and the new-made forces of Eaerlann fought over two hundred years. This mark the Seven Citadels' War, some called the Sixth Crown War.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Circa: Members of House Dlardrageth establish five secret armories within the north-eastern High Forest, an area that is considered Eaerlanni territory at the time.
cites: Mintiper's Chapbook: Part 6

events.text: Jhaamdath establishes Corrant as the Eleventh City of the Sword.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: During the Seven Citadels' War, Eaerlann is winning against Siluvanede. The Siluvanedenn react by opening a number of ancient citadels of Aryvandaar and collecting Vyshaantar weapons. Sharrven is drawn into the war in response.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Torhild Flametongue founds Besilmer, a dwarven realm on the Sword Coast North.
cites: Dwarves Deep, с. 53
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: The Return of the Dark occurs in central Faerûn, when a combined force of duergar and drow raid and pillage the Elven Court and the dwarven realm of Sarphil. The Dark Court Slaughter slays many elven clan leaders, including the coronals Jhyrennstar and Rystall Wood. The Elven Court was pillaged and deserted. Sarphil was divided in two to be ruled by the invading forces.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 129
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 26–27
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 32–33

events.text: Following the deaths of his family at the hands of drow, Shevarash vows to Corellon to become the Seldarine's weapon and kill Lolth and all the drow.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 33
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: The deaths of their coronals see the ends of the Seventh and Fifth Rysars of Rystall Wood and Jhyrennstar, respectively. The wizardess Enajharas becomes coronal in Rystall Wood, marking the Eighth Rysar, and Oacenth, prophet of Labelas Enoreth, becomes coronal in Jhyrennstar, marking the Sixth Rysar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Elven leaders call for war against the drow, now that they have learned the nature of their enemy.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: A suspicious plague known as the Silent Death alongside a mysterious blight afflicts the cities of Lower Imaskar. The disease and famine lead to widespread death, and Lower Imaskar's priests are powerless to help, causing the people to turn against their gods.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 18
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: The period of Shartra, meaning "darkness", begins in Imaskari civilization.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 18
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Imaskari artificers open a pair of gates to another world, from which the Imaskari take thousands of human slaves. The artificers then close the gates and create a planar barrier that blocks all contact between the slaves and their deities on that world.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: The Imaskari begin marrying or producing children with these slaves, and gradually produce the Mulan people.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Circa: The Seven Citadels' War comes to an end.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Circa: Eaerlann annexes Siluvanede with the use of force. The true nature of the fey'ri is discovered.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Thaeravel, the Land of Alabaster Towers, is founded in the lands that later become the Anauroch. Rasilith becomes its capital.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Circa: To avoid being associated with the fey'ri houses, uncorrupted Siluvanedenn High Mages place their own city of Myth Adofhaer in magical stasis, so they might come back in the distant future.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Circa: The majority of surviving fey'ri are imprisoned in the Nameless Dungeon, Nar Kerymhoarth. A few evade capture and found their own demon-tained elven noble houses.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Jhaamdath establishes Mirrindith the Last as the Twelfth City of the Sword.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 26

events.text: Coronal Enajharas of Rystall Wood is persuaded by her nobles that the elves of Jhyrennstar conspire against them. She cuts all relations with Arcorar, isolating Rystall Wood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: The dwarven realm of Besilmer falls after attacks by giants and humanoids.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: The dwarven subterranean fortress city of Tyar-Besil, in Besilmer, is abandoned and forgotten.
cites: Princes of the Apocalypse, с. 19

events.text: The dwarven kingdom of Ammarindar is founded.
cites: Perilous Gateways: The Shadow Path

events.text: The death of Shevarash the Black Archer.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 33
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Shevarash ascends to godhood, becoming a demigod of the Seldarine. He continues to be a hunter and slayer of drow, but directs his vengeance against Lolth and Vhaeraun themselves (though he no longer considers Eilistraee and her worshipers to be among his prey).
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 33
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Circa: A duergar slave revolt sees them escape from mind flayer domination.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Coronal Oacenth of Jhyrennstar dies of sickness.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 125
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 129
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 27

events.text: Circa: The freed duergar settle beneath the Orsraun Mountains, in the northern Underdark, and in distant caverns under the Great Glacier.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Circa: The leShay of Sarifal forge an alliance with Imaskar after regular visits from their artificers.

With Oacenth's dying wish of a united empire of elves, the Elfblades and the Ruling Trials are created and Kahvoerm Irithyl draws the Rulers' Blade, uniting Jhyrennstar, Semberholme, and Elven Court into Cormanthyr.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 125
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 129

events.text: The Coronal Kahvoerm Irithyl of Cormanthyr founds the city of Cormanthor (later Myth Drannor) with the summoning of the Rule Tower.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 27
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 125
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 130

events.text: The commencement of the Late period of Imaskari civilization.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Menzoberra the Kinless founds Menzoberranzan.
cites: Races of Faerûn, с. 35
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Circa: The dwarf realm of Delzoun is established.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Lord Artificer Omanond commands Imaskari artificers to fashion the Imaskarcana. These seven items store the entirety of the Imaskar Empire's knowledge of magic.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Nether the Elder becomes ruler of the fishing village of Gers in Faerûn's north.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Following fighting with House S'sril, House Nasadra is exiled from Menzoberranzan and House Baenre rises to become First House.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: The Narrow Sea fishing villages of Fenwick, Gers, Gilan, Gustaf, Moran, Nauseef, and Janick band together for mutual protection and form the Alliance of Seventon. To celebrate the forging of the alliance, Nether the Elder creates the Netheril Year (NY) calendar.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 5
