events.text: The First Age of Netheril begins.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 5

events.text: Nether the Elder demands more and more tribute from the inhabitants of Seventon and renames the community Netheril, which means Nether's Land.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Nether the Elder's son Alandril Nether, also known as Nether the Younger, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Selûnites establish the Abbey of the Moon in Netheril. Built atop the tallest of the Dragonsheart Mountains, the range is renamed the Abbey Mountains in honour of the building.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27
Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 64

events.text: The inhabitants of Netheril are quietly watched by the Eaerlanni elves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27
Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 5

events.text: House Nasadra founds the city of Ched Nasad. This triggers centuries of conflict between the drow of Ched Nasad and the dwarves of Ammarindar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 84

events.text: After formally contacting the humans of Netheril, the Eaerlanni elves begin instructing the Netherese in the art of magic. Therion of Gers becomes the first Netherese arcanist.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Nether the Elder is murdered.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Through democracy, the Netherese elect Nether the Younger to take control of Netheril after his father's death.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Bands of hobgoblins settle the area around the around the Gorge of the Fallen Idol and River Ith, also known as the Wurlur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Alandril Nether, also known as Nether the Younger, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: The dwarven realm of Oghrann suffers attacks on all sides, from bugbears, goblinoids, and trolls, as well as lizardfolk, nomadic human tribes, and wemics. It falls to disease and war.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Gracklstugh, City of Blades, is founded by duergar, and is the first duergar city in the North. Without rivals, its control spreads through the surrounding middle and upper Underdark.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: An orc horde rampages out of the Spine of the World. The elves of Illefarn and Eaerlann force them back, assisted by the Netherese Empire and the Rengarth barbarians.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Netheril absorbs the lands of the Rengarth tribes, but the tribes themselves remain essentially autonomous.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: The Netherese have begun learning magic from the Earlanni elves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: An awesomely powerful sarrukh lich disguises himself as a human archwizard called Arthindol. Arthindol visits the Netherese now and at various points in the coming centuries without apparent age, and teaches them further secrets of arcane magic. They call him "Terraseer" for his ability to see events all around the world.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Rock gnomes dwelling in neighboring hills are enslaved by the Netherese.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: The Netherese fishing village of Zenith is established with the aim of it becoming a great port city in the future.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 93

events.text: The dwarves of Gharraghaur are distracted by their mining efforts and neglect their defenses when orcs attack. Gharraghaur falls to the orcs, the first dwarven kingdom to do so.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: A legion of orcs from the Spine of the World launch a major invasion of the nation of Netheril. It lasts nineteen years before the Netherese and elven armies turn them back.
cites: Races of Faerûn, с. 64–65

events.text: The port of Runlatha is founded by the Netherese on the Narrow Sea.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 28

events.text: Rengarth barbarians establish the port of Frostypaw on the Narrow Sea around this year.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 73

events.text: The Nether Scrolls are discovered by Finder, a Netherese human, within the ruins of Aryvandaar. The Netherese give up the arcane magic they learned from Eaerlann, and take to the magic described in the Nether Scrolls, which promise greater power.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 5

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Circa: The couatl population of the Chultan Peninsula mysteriously begins an alarming decline.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 28

events.text: The legendary Netherese arcanist Tarchamus the Unyielding destroyed the floating city of Tenish with his volcano spell.
Congenio Ioun, creator of ioun stones, is born in Netheril.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 6
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 27

events.text: Annagoth, a popular Netherese arcanist, falls into the icy waters of the northeast Narrow Sea at his son's wedding. The entire bay is named Annagoth's Bay in his honor.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 65

events.text: Congenio Ioun creates the first Congenio's pebble—items that later became known as ioun stones.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 6
Netheril: Empire of Magic: Encyclopedia Arcana, с. 5–6

events.text: The Netherese learn of the shield dwarves of Delzoun.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 28

events.text: The settlement of Conch is established at the base of the Column of the Sky Mountains. The land is sacred to the Rengarth who widely proclaim that the town is cursed. Caravans in the vicinity are attacked by barbarians as well as the settlement itself.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 69

events.text: At Ascore, the Netherese contact the dwarves of Delzoun and propose trade between them. Negotiations take three years.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 28–29

events.text: Following three years of negotiation, trade commences between the Netherese and the dwarves of Delzoun. The Lowroad is established to link Delzoun to Netherese settlements. It runs through the most secure portions of the Underdark.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 28–29

events.text: At the suggestion of a close friend, the Netherese arcanist Congenio Ioun renames his Congenio's pebbles to Ioun's stones.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 6
Netheril: Empire of Magic: Encyclopedia Arcana, с. 5–6

events.text: The Ninth Rysar of Rystall Wood begins.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Hobgoblins and their dwarf slaves construct a gigantic statue to Nomog-Geaya, the hobgoblin god, in the Gorge of Nomog-Geaya the Warrior. The gorge becomes a gathering place for hobgoblin tribes for three centuries, though they are obstructed by the dwarves of Shanatar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Netherese arcanists conquer Thaeravel. They steal a number of new spells from the minds of the sorcerers.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: The duergar King Horgar Steelshadow II founds the Deepkingdom, and takes Gracklstugh as his capital. Horgar claims all duergar settlements west of the Buried Realms and north of the Sharnlands as the Deepkingdom's domain.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: The dwarves of Haunghdannar send out many ships, but none return save for coast-hugging fishing boats. The realm dwindles, and it overrun by bugbears, ogres, orcs, and trolls.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Elves establish the village of Hoyden in the Hidden Forest to put aside squabbling between the home nations of its residents. It becomes a haven for weaponsmiths after some of the first silver weapons are forged here. Advances in weaponry continue to be made in Hoyden until the Shadowed Age of Netheril.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 76

events.text: King Azkuldar of Ammarindar opens trade with the Netherese.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: The Sunset Plague slaughters nearly the entire population of Calimport in less than a tenday, including more than half of the ruling Marekh Dynasty. Calimport lies empty for nearly a century afterward, out of fear.
cites: Calimport, с. 14

events.text: Daud yn Khadil el Marekh survives the plague to become the final ruler of the Marekh Dynasty and of the First Age of Calimshan.
cites: Calimport, с. 14

events.text: A forest fire destroys the Abbey of the Moon in Netheril. There are many unsuccessful attempts to reconstruct it.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Bakkal Daud yn Khadil el Marekh dies, ending the Marekh Dynasty of the First Age of Calimshan.
cites: Calimport, с. 14

events.text: Ioulaum is born and becomes one of Netheril's greatest archwizards.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Kraken emerge from the Trench of Lopok and tear apart the Numosi and Jhimari schools of the Dukars.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Circa: The military outpost of Unity is established in a joint effort between the Netherese, the elves and the dwarves as a staging point for military operations against orcs and goblinoids.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 90

events.text: After nearly a century of no rule in Calimport, the Pahlemn Dynasty of Calimshan is founded, ushering in that nation's Second Age.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 15
Calimport, с. 14

events.text: The Imaskari build the outpost of Metos in the Methwood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Wemics rout a major Jhaamdathan army when it enters their hunting grounds in the Golden Plains.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 25

events.text: A new Abbey of the Moon is founded at the headwaters of the Gillan River.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 74

events.text: By some accounts, this is the beginning of the Second Age of Calimshan, though that age's first dynasty began 50 years prior.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 40

events.text: To assist in the escape of gnome slaves from Netheril, the Trail of Mists is created.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: A large number of gnome refugees of Netherese slavery settle in the Sunrise Mountains. They found the secret kingdom of Songfarla.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Led by Ioulaum, the Netherese assault a horde of orcs by the southern Plain of Standing Stones. They exterminate the orcs and Netheril expands without restriction into the south and west.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: One of the Rampant Peaks is renamed Thunder Peak thanks to the conflict between Netheril and the orcs.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 90

events.text: An avalanche on a small mountain in Netheril reveals the bones of many humans and orcs from a narrowly won battle two years ago. Those who discover the remains name the mountain Bone Hill.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 66

events.text: Vandal Station is established by the Rengarth. Named for the Vandal tribe of barbarians, Vandal Station becomes known for its adventurous warriors who patrol the Rengarth ancestral lands and occasionally the Cold Forest.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 91

events.text: An earthquake alters the course of the Hale River, flooding a lush valley west of the God's Legion Mountains. The resulting lake is named Basin Lake.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 65

events.text: The agricultural town of Grog is founded. Known only for one thing—a disgusting beverage named after the town popular among sailors—it is otherwise completely unremarkable.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 74

events.text: Khopeshes first appear in Netheril.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 31

events.text: Circa: Coming from the west, seafaring humans colonize the island of Ruathym in the Sea of Swords.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Elves from Cormanthyr steal a copy of the Nether Scrolls. They conceal it in Windsong Tower.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Rilmohx Sha'Quessir, a gnome and elf-friend who was one of the thieves, looks at one of the scrolls and instantly receives knowledge of how to use illusion spells. The knowledge quickly propagates throughout gnome culture.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: The first mythallar is created by Ioulaum.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: The first quasimagical item powered by a mythallar is fashioned by Ioulaum.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 6

events.text: The Dukars must now swear oath of fealty to the empire of Aryselmalyr and its coronal.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: High Mages set up a mythal around Nantar, a town on the Hmur Plateau. The city becomes Myth Nantar, City of Destinies, and a center of magical research and education, of both elven and marid magic.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: The Dukars found a new academy in Myth Nantar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: The drow city of Sshamath experienced a civil war. All matriarchs who worship Lolth are killed and the house wizards take power.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Kuo-toa establish Sloopdilmonpolop, the City of Pools, off the coast of Tethyr in the Underdark.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Migrating from the island of Ruathym Illuskan humans settled at the mouth of the River Mirar. They displace the Ice Hunter tribes that dwelt in the area and build the settlement of Old Illusk.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: The couatls seek allies against the yuan-ti in the western end of the Chultan Peninsula. They go to another continent, lying far to the southwest of Faerûn, and preach about the god Ubtao to the native human tribes.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: This year marks the end of The Founding Time and the beginning of the Age of Humanity, in which human civilizations in Faerûn commence a marked expansion and rise to dominance.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: The frontier town of Dagger's Point is founded along the Wolfsberg River. Idyllic at first, it is soon filled with rogues and thugs who reject Ioulaum's vision of High Netheril.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 70

events.text: The archmage Ioulaum creates the flying Netherese enclave of Xinlenal.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 97
Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 7

events.text: Five gloaming families on the Plane of Shadow ally in mutual defense. They found the community of Sphur Upra.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: The city of Harborage erects a mythallar, creating many quasimagical devices that turn it into the most advanced port in Low Netheril.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 75

events.text: The Netherese city of Cantus is sacked by the goblins that they were trying to trade with when the goblins learn that the Netherese have no interest in their trade goods.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 68

events.text: A weather-controlling mythallar is erected in Zenith but even its powerful magic is not enough to mitigate the awful northern weather. Zenith also had no chance to compete with the other northern trading ports—Harborage and Runlatha—so it is abandoned by the Netherese (though still occasionally frequented by Rengarth and Angardt tribes).
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 93

events.text: The Ironstar Kingdom of shield dwarves is founded beneath Firstpeak (Ironstar Mountain).
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29
Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark, с. 35

events.text: Circa: The woodcutting camp that will eventually grow into the city of Coniferia is established in the Eastern Forest.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 69

events.text: Coronal Kahvoerm Irithyl of Cormanthyr dies.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 125
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Divisav Irithyl, first son of Kahvoerm Irithyl, dies trying to draw the Rulers' Blade, which deems him unworthy of being coronal.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 125

events.text: Sakrattars Irithyl, Kahvoerm youngest great grandson, ascends to the throne of Cormanthyr. This marks the beginning of the Second Rysar of Cormanthyr.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 125
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29

events.text: Spellcasting ghosts occupy the ruins of the original Abbey of the Moon. Several adventuring parties and questing holy men try to clear the abbey but none return.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 64

events.text: The ogre city of Chanth is cleansed of life in a single week by the forces of arcanist Miren when they refuse to leave their city and the surrounding fertile land. The city is renamed Canlespiere by the Netherese.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 67

events.text: The ogres of the lands surrounding Canlespiere are finally driven away. Three thousand ogres lost their lives over the past seven years of fighting, but this period, known as the 'Ogre's Stand', also claims the lives of two thousand low-level human arcanists and warriors.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 67

events.text: The adult amethyst dragon Gembright claims the northern waters of the Channel Lock as her own. She occasionally entertains Netherese arcanists who wish to discuss magic or dragons with her.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 68

events.text: The Pahlemn Dynasty of the Second Age of Calimshan ends.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 15–16

events.text: The Tavihr Dynasty of Calimshan begins.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 15–16

events.text: Goblin tribes and orcs fearing extinction attempt to raze Seventon after managing to draw away its defenders. They are swiftly put down - though only with the help of Ioulaum. The survivors flee to the goblin-infested ruins of Cantus and come into conflict with the inhabitants. Dwarves from Ascore and Netherese from Sanctuary wipe out all of those left in the ruins.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 7
Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 68

events.text: In the eastern jungles of the Chultan Peninsula, the enslaved Lapal tribes revolt against their yuan-ti masters.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 30

events.text: On Katashaka, the continent southwest of Faerûn, a number of tribes, including the Eshowe, Tabaxi, and Thinguth, accept the couatls' preachings of Ubtao. Following the couatls, they migrate across the seas to the Wild Coast of the Chultan Peninsula and travel to the Peaks of Flame. There, an avatar of Ubtao welcomes them.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 29
Serpent Kingdoms, с. 121

events.text: The Thinguth tribe settle in the central jungles of the Sanrach and Thindol Basins.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 30

events.text: The town of Remembrance is established and soon comes to be predominantly populated by followers of Jannath.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 85

events.text: The city of Imbrue is founded as a place to farm, fish and raise livestock.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 77

events.text: Circa: The fey'ri of Siluvanede help the monstrous creatures of the southern High Forest to flourish in number, which causes the elf realm of Sharrven to collapse. Survivors escape to Eaerlann and Evereska.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 30

events.text: Circa: King Connar IV of Ammarindar assaults these monsters and slays many. Among them is the red dragon Rithaerosurffel, the Bane of Sharrven.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 84
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Netheril forms a new government, a council named the High Mages of Netheril. It comprises the top arcanists of Low and High Netheril.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: The Silver Age of Netheril commences.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Netherese begin to dig the mines of Dekanter.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: The House of Tyche, a huge temple to Tyche, the goddess of luck, is constructed in Imbrue. Used mostly as a massive gambling den, it proves to be the main draw for visitors to the city.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 77

events.text: The city of Arisome, established this year, quickly comes under repeated attack by the orcs of the Hidden Forest. When the city enacts a bounty on orc ears, the huge collection gathered causes the city to be renamed Earsome.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 71

events.text: Arctic Rim, a Netherese militia outpost, is established on the edge of the Rengarth Tundra. Some credit it as the northernmost city of the Empire of Netheril but no more than 250 people ever live there at the same time.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 65

events.text: Circa: A tribe of lizardfolk ruled by a lizard king move into the Marsh of Simplicity. They harass local villages and Rengarth tribes for centuries to come.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 80

events.text: Circa: The Gate of Iron is constructed as a barrier against the approaching Imaskari forces. It is sited on the only accessible pass in the Dustwall Mountains between the Raurin and the lands to the south that would later be known as Durpar and Ulgarth.
cites: The Horde: Volume I, с. 49

events.text: The central temple of Moander's faith is constructed at the headwaters of the Pox River in the southern reaches of Moander's Footstep. The priests here believe that after the draconic pantheon arrived, Moander poisoned the water and food supply of the Creator Races at this place, helping the dragons to wipe them out.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 80

events.text: The flying enclave of Quagmire is established by an archwizard known only by his devout worship of Targus. The mysterious archwizard forces all residents of the enclave to worship his god, creating a powerful barbarous army.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 83

events.text: Imaskari build the port city of Bhaluin.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Orc tribes living on the Rengarth Tundra, starving due to a particularly harsh winter, travel south and come into conflict with the residents of Runlatha.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 82

events.text: Gold dwarves found the kingdom of Dareth under King Orloebar Snowbeard.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: The city of Mezro is founded by an avatar of Ubtao in Chult.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Three separate groups of Amaunatans fleeing Sharran persecution converge on the Cede River. Putting aside their ideological differences, they focus on their similarities and create a community called Trinity. There they form their own Amaunatan sect, which is much more socially accepting and relaxed than other denominations, going so far as to make much profit off of rival Jannath worshipers who visit the town before heading to a nearby shrine.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 90

events.text: A monster nicknamed Diemondar ("jaws of death" in Loross) begins attacking fishing vessels in Basin Lake. Though numerous hunters search for it, it is cunning enough to elude them.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 65–66

events.text: Realising that the Netherese are more likely to trade with permanent settlements, the normally nomadic Rengarth barbarian tribes establish the community of Coldfoot to trade with Ascore, Low Netheril and the Angardt.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 68

events.text: The flying enclave of Sanctuary is established as a haven for pacifists.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 85

events.text: Circa: The last surviving dwarves of High Shanatar fall in battle against the Tavihr Dynasty of Calimshan, by the Sulduskoon River.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Circa: Dwarves of Deep Shanatar seal the last known passage from the surface to their realm.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: The drow begin construction of the Twisted Tower in the area that would later become Shadowdale. It would be completed in -2549 DR.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 34
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: The Deepkingdom of the duergar in the North reaches the peak of its power.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Xenophobes establish the city of Xanth. Although not banned from entering, demihumans are hounded by the city constabulary and condemned to death for the slightest infraction of the law.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 93

events.text: Divinations reveal a powerful undead creature is responsible for the loss of an adventuring party on Thunder Peak. None of the expeditions sent to confirm its existence return with any evidence.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 90

events.text: Arcanist Zwei develops extension I as the first arcane spell recorded as a Netherese invention.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22, 25, 26

events.text: Netherese arcanist Zwei creates the second of his or her extension spells.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22, 25, 26

events.text: Netherese arcanist Zwei creates the third and most powerful extension spell.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22, 25, 26

events.text: The sea god Ulutiu goes into exile on the Astral Plane. He leaves his ice necklace to sink, and it creates the Great Glacier.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Year 0 of the Ulutiun Calendar.
cites: The Great Glacier, с. 5

events.text: Drow complete construction on the Twisted Tower (begun in -2600 DR), despite continued attacks and efforts to stop them. From here, they establish their presence in the area that would become Shadowdale.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31
Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 34

events.text: Congenio Ioun, creator of ioun stones, dies aged 955.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 6

events.text: [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steel#History_of_steelmaking Steelmaking] technology in Netheril progresses to the point where chain mail armor becomes available.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 31

events.text: A group of Netherese who hate arcane magic establish the city of Monikar in the southern Eastern Forest. They trade exclusively with dwarves for weapons and mundane explosives.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 80

events.text: The flying enclave of Spiel is established as a center for learning, a collective for historians and sages as well as a haven for nonhumans.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 88

events.text: Ioun's stones become generally known as simply ioun stones.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: Encyclopedia Arcana, с. 6

events.text: Led by the ancient deity Ptah, the deities of the Mulan slaves of the Imaskari bypass the planar barrier by sending manifestations through space to Toril. In Faerûn, they create incarnations and return to their faithful. Some are made priests while others become divine minions.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Bolstered by their gods, the Mulan rebel against the Imaskari slavers.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Lord Artificer Yuvaraj, Emperor of Imaskar, is killed by the god Horus.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Following the rebellion of the Mulan slaves, the city of Inupras falls and Empire of Imaskari in Raurin is destroyed. The devastation wrought in the empire's fall turns the site into the Raurin Desert. Exiles fleeing Raurin's destruction settle on the Alamber Sea.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 268
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31
Old Empires, с. 5

events.text: Lord Hilather, one of the last surviving Imaskari artificers hides in a temporal stasis vault in a secret military base under the Giant's Belt Mountains.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Lord Ilphemon and his family and retainers retreat into the unexplored Underdark. They eventually settle Deep Imaskar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Imaskar's subject-states of Durpar and Gundavar (latter known as Estagund and Var the Golden) collapse and descend into barbarism.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: After the fall of the western Imaskar Empire, the eastern provinces of Khati and Katakoro survive. The artificer Kujawa takes Dhonas's Shroud, one of the seven False Imaskarcana, and names himself Emperor of Anok-Imaskar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: This event marks the beginning of the First Age of Shou Lung.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Former Imaskari slaves migrate to the Alamber Sea.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 61

events.text: Imaskari refugees flee to the Underdark.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 61

events.text: Imaskari refugees carry the Third Imaskarcana to the Underdark.
cites: Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 61

events.text: The Netherese city of Tenish is destroyed by the arcanist Tarchamus with his powerful spell Tarchamus' volcano in retaliation for being censured over his extreme beliefs.
cites: Lesser Evils, с. 15

events.text: The Netherese House Orogoth constructs a fortified villa on the southern edge of the High Moor, by the Serpent Hills. From here, generations of Orogoths seek the power of dragons.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Lord Ilphemon of fallen Imaskar establishes the hidden city of Deep Imaskar in the Underdark's Earthroot domain.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Arcanist-priest Sadebreth successfully creates an arcane version of the divine spell reincarnate.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22, 24, 26, 108

events.text: The Great Glacier expands south, covering the lands that would one day be known as Damara and Vaasa.
cites: The Great Glacier, с. 5

events.text: Seeking to preserve their forest home of Lethyr and neighboring lands, elves use High Magic to halt the advance of the Great Glacier and regulate temperatures.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Netherese arcanist-priest Sadebreth develops the spell control undead.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22, 24, 26, 108

events.text: Forced south by the advancing Great Glacier, Nar human tribes and hobgoblins clash with the elves of Lethyr and each other.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Rengarth barbarians from Vandal Station battle Netherese miners crossing their ancestral lands, some of whom are guilty of grave-robbing.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 91

events.text: The city of Harborage begins trading with the Amanir clan of cloud giants.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 75

events.text: The drow cause the Spiderfires, destroying much of Rystall Wood and separating it from the main body of Cormanthor and the empire of Cormanthyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Seven of Netheril's extant Nether Scrolls are returned by unnamed thief to ancient ruins of the creator races: three to the Hall of Mists beneath the High Forest, two to the Crypt of Hssthak in the western Anauroch, and the whereabouts of the remaining two are unknown.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 31

events.text: Beholders fighting in the Caltazar Hills set fire to the northeastern Forest of Mir.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 41

events.text: The Netherese arcanist Toscudlo invents his spell Toscudlo's illusionary wall, which later becomes known as illusory wall.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 27

events.text: The hallucinatory terrain spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Toscudlo with the name Toscudlo's hallucinatory terrain.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 24,27

events.text: Battles erupt in Earsome when an investigation into why a troll ear (that then grew into a troll) was in the collection of an important local family. It reveals the culprits as political opponents who attack the investigating adventurers.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 71

events.text: Coronal Essyl retaliates against minor koalinth and scrag raids in the north of Serôs. This unites koalinths and merrow against the sea elves, triggering the Third Serôs War.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: The sea elves of Aryselmalyr topple the merrow kingdom of P'karnis in Serôs.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: In the Third Serôs War, the Imperium of Ilvanyv, the ixitxachitl nation, falls.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: Disgusted by the oppression and violence of the war, the merfolk of Thalorlyn rebel.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: To disrupt the merfolk rebellion, Coronal Essyl of Aryselmyr supports a merfolk traitor, Kyron the Mad, who is also influenced by Dagon. Although Kyron becomes a leader among merfolk, he gives their military secrets to Essyl.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: Elves from Cormanthor go beyond the River Lis to found Yrlaphon among the eastern woodlands.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 34
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 126
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: The merfolk of Thalorlyn declare themselves independent and establish the First Kingdom of Hmur. They claim Myth Nantar as their own.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: Aryselmalyr quashes the rebellion at Thalorlyn and slaughters some 30% of all merfolk in Serôs.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: A plague wipes out the population of Bandor Village. 4,000 more die from it at nearby Vandal Station. The few Rengarth survivors, unable to perform their duty of patrolling the ancestral lands, mostly move to Frostypaw.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 65
Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 91

events.text: Frontier wars between the humans of Calimshan and the elves of Tethyr flare up, and fighting would continue until -1300 DR.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 22

events.text: Coronal Essyl of Aryselmyr sends his agents on an expedition into the deepest Trench of Lopok. They come back alongside three fiendish kraken who serve Dagon and carry the Emerald Eye artifact.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: Essyl gives the Emerald Eye to Kyron the Mad, the merfolk leader, to ensure his loyalty. Strengthened by the kraken, Essyl and Kyron seize increased power across Serôs.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: In the Third Serôs War, the Dukar Order of Nantari, serving Aryselmalyr, triggers war against the other Dukar orders, in the First Dukars' War.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: The merfolk King Kyron of Thalorlyn defeats the Horde of the Bloodtide, an alliance of koalinth and merrow.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: Learning that Kyron and Coronal Essyl of Aryselmalyr are allied with kraken, some merfolk rebel and create the Republic of Tivaan. They unite the Hmur Plateau in rebellion against the mad kings.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: King Kyron of the merfolk kingdom of Thalorlyn is deposed. He and his loyalists are exiled from the Hmur Plateau.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 35

events.text: In Myth Nantar, the House of the Nantari Order of Dukars ends the First Dukars' War. This sets back the plans of Coronal Essyl of Aryselmalyr. Though tense, relations in Serôs remain calm for twenty years.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Suffering frequent attacks from Coronal Essyl's forces, the normallly isolationist morkoths of the Four Arcana of Humbar ally with Tivaan.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The project image spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Toscudlo with the name Toscudlo's project image.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 24,27

events.text: Dagon launches his plan to dominate Serôs.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: A wildtide portal opens between opens in Serôs and the Sea of Corynactis, on the other side of Toril. Travelling through the portal shalarins arrive in Serôs in the First Shalarin Passing.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Coronal Essyl and the exiled merfolk Kyron with the magically attuned Emerald Eye immediately attack the shalarins. Over 17% of the shalarins are killed. The Dukar orders, Humbar, and Tivaan quickly move to help the shalarins, and are aided by powerful allies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Lady Polaris is born in Netheril.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 112

events.text: The exiled merfolk king Kyron is slain by Dukars, who confiscate the Emerald Eye. Some remaining merfolk traitors return to Tivaan, while others stay with Coronal Essyl.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The armies of Unther push through the Akana frontier. Led by the hero Hlath, the Jhaamdathan defenders attempt to halt the Untheric invasion at Inixrien, but they are defeated. The eastern provinces of Jhaamdath fall under the sway of Unther.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 25
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Essyl Merynth, the Mad Coronal of Aryselmalyr is killed by his brother, Grand Dukar Jholar of the Dukars. Jholar takes the throne but abdicates, naming his sister Vaeqiis, a devout priestess, as the new coronal. This ends the Third Serôs War.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The Dukars reform as an organization of peacekeepers, independent of Aryselmalyr. They dissolve the Nantari Order and rebuild their school in Myth Nantar as an academy where the remaining four orders can meet. The Dukars keep a close watch on the sea elves of Aryselmalyr and their magic.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Circa: Mulhorandi expand and settle the Priador.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Circa: Untherites expand and settle the Wizards' Reach and the majority of the Eastern Shaar.
Circa: Mulhorand annexes Murghôm, the Plains of Purple Dust, and the Raurin Desert.
Netherese arcanist Toscudlo invents the advanced illusion spell and calls it Toscudlo's advanced illusion.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22, 24, 27

events.text: By this time, eastern Jhaamdath is completely under the control of Unther.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 25

events.text: On the northeastern Hmur Plateau, shalarin who survived the Third Serôs War settle Es'krin.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Shalarin make alliances with the Dukars and Humbar, who protect Es'krin until they can develop their own defense force.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The arcanist known as Brightfinger is assassinated by the Ashwind Assassins for an unknown reason.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 109

events.text: Mulhorand conquers Semphar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The spell darkness, 15' radius is invented by the Netherese arcanist Fahren.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 27

events.text: The spell greater invisibility is invented by the Netherese arcanist Pockall.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 27

events.text: The demand spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Toscudlo with the name Toscudlo's dominate.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 24,27

events.text: The invisibility spell is invented by the Netherese arcanist Pockall, originally called Pockall's invisibility.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 24,27

events.text: The permanent image spell is invented by the Netherese arcanist Toscudlo, originally called Toscudlo's permanent illusion.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 24,27

events.text: The city of Xanth defeats a force of 12,000 orcs. They dismember the enemy survivors and send them back to their clan as a warning.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 93

events.text: The spell glitterdust is invented by the Netherese arcanist Fahren.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 27

events.text: The Netherese enclave of Thultanthar, the City of Shade, is founded. It is a centre of study of the planes. The enclave quickly gains an ill reputation as it is entirely and constantly bathed in magical darkness.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36
Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 87

events.text: The invisibility sphere spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Pockall with the name Pockall's wide invisibility.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 24,27

events.text: Netherese arcanist Pockall invents the spell Pockall's monster hex, later known as charm monster.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22, 24, 27

events.text: The mass invisibility spell is developed by Netherese arcanist Toscudlo under the name Toscudlo's bulk invisibility. It is the last recorded spell invention for more than one and a half centuries.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22, 24, 27

events.text: The death of Syl-Pasha Violir el Cajaan IX in Calimport.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Calimport falls and Qyraaptir the Bloodeye, a beholder mage, claims the throne of the pasha. Beholders rule the ruins of Calimport, and all large settlements across Calimshan, Iltkazar, and the Lake of Steam.
Naturally, trade between Calimshan and Tzindylspar suddenly comes to a halt.
Tzindylspar falls to an army of monsters from Calimshan, led by Ynamalik Nadim el Cajaan.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The flying enclave of Shadowtop Borough is conquered by archwizard Requiar after he kills thirty other archwizards while wearing the Crown of Horns.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 87

events.text: The fishing community of Heldapan is settled, becoming a center of trade.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Seeking vengeance for the destruction of the Cajaan Dynasty, humans lay siege to beholder-occupied Calimport. While trying to smoke out the beholders, the humans set fire to some of the outer sabbans.
cites: Calimport, с. 15

events.text: Drakhon priests and human allies attack and force Qyraaptir the Bloodeye and the beholders out of Calimport. Over the next three years, they liberate Calimshan of beholder rule. The beholders return to their lairs in the Alimir Mountains and the Lake of Steam.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Drakhon pashas assume power in Calimshan.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The island-city of Delia is raised as a Netherese enclave by Lady Polaris.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 70

events.text: As the natural traditions of Delia are quickly subsumed by the fast-paced life normal in other enclaves. The elves and druids of the city leave in droves despite their original agreement to its ascension.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 70

events.text: Coronal Faahresc takes power in Rystall Wood, beginning its Eleventh Rysar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Faahresc, a vehemently anti-drow warrior, begins launching many raids into the Underdark and on the Twisted Tower to slay them.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Beholders of the Lake of Steam cease their attacks on the Caltazar Hills.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Circa: The lizard king of the Marsh of Simplicity is overthrown by the Lizardfolk shaman known as Gr'Zhad. Gr'Zhad and his tribe prove to be the bane of the village of Zenith - constantly raiding it and evading any who come after him. Such is Gr'Zhad's long life and apparent power that some netherese suspect him to be Ioulaum in disguise demonstrating how vulnerable Low Netheril settlements are.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 80

events.text: Circa: Untherites spread over the Alamber, using crude, early ships to ply the open waters of the Sea of Fallen Stars. Such ships remain in use for 2000 years.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Calimshan is completely freed from beholders.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: A horde of koalinth and merrow overrun the Hmur Plateau, commencing the Fourth Serôs War. The merfolk Republic of Tivaan falls.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: In desperation to force out the invaders, a mermaid enters the Dukars' Tower in Myth Nantar to steal the Emerald Eye. But its power corrupts her, and she leads the horde against her people and Serôs.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The Fourth Serôs War comes to an end with the destruction of the Second Kingdom of Kyron, and the possessed mermaid leader of the koalinth and merrow horde is believed dead on the Plains of Duna. The Dukars recapture the Emerald Eye. The koalinth suffer a setback that will take them decades to recover from.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The surviving merfolk reform as the kingdom of Thalvan under King Darmox and the protection of the kinder Coronal Vaeqiis of Aryselmalyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The various civil wars long-experienced on the frontiers of Calimshan's territory are finally crushed.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 17

events.text: The Angardt tribe of the Rengarth barbarians learns sorcery, beginning a schism in their culture.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The artificer Tan Chin finds powerful Imaskari artifacts in the ruins of Thakos. He uses them to assassinate the Sapphire Empress Kwan Ying and seizes the throne of Shou Lung. Now emperor, Tan Chin renames the city of Ten Mor Shou to Kuo Meilan, for his consort.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The sorcery-using Angardt tribe splits from the magic-fearing Rengarth tribe.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The earliest historical mention of the Black Leopard Cult is made, mentioning their temples along the Fenghsintzu River.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Emperor Tan Chin of Shou Ling and his friend Kar Wuan trick the Guardian dragon Pao Hu Jen into flying to the Hordelands. They use the Jade Mirror to transform the dragon into the Great Dragonwall.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Some Ulutiuns discover the Glacier of Ulutiu and translate some of its writings. Those who chose to remain in Nakvaligach to worship Ulutiu become the Nakulutiuns. Those who reject Ulutiu and return to Alpuk become the Iulutiuns.
cites: The Great Glacier, с. 6

events.text: Circa: Sharrans, ends their migration to the region of Sepulcher and finish construction of a large temple there known as the House of Mystery..
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 86

events.text: An alliance of Cormanthyr and Rystall Wood forces infiltrate and rout the drow forces around and beneath Rystall, in the ruins of Uvaeren, and at the Old Skull. They fail to take the Twisted Tower, so a large number of drow escape them.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: The Deepbear Battles come to an end as the quaggoth nation of Ursadunthar is destroyed by the duergar of Gracklstugh.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 34
Underdark, с. 117

events.text: Coronal Miirphys Irithyl takes power in Cormanthyr, beginning its Fourth Rysar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: A military road between Zazesspur and Memnon is completed and almost immediately is dominated by merchant traffic.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 23
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 17

events.text: The frontier wars (begun in -1530 DR) between the humans of Calimshan and the elves of Tethyr at last come to an end.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 22–23

events.text: Construction is begun of a military road between Zazesspur and the eastern reaches of the Calishite Empire at Ithal Pass. The road would take almost 200 years to complete.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 22–23

events.text: Netherese arcanist Hamring invents two spells, ray of enfeeblement and scare.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 27

events.text: Maldraedior, the suzerain of the blue dragons of Unther and Mulhorand, abdicates, retreating to his lair in the Smoking Mountains near Dalath.
cites: Draconomicon (1990), с. 91

events.text: The spells feeblemind, hypnotism, and mass suggestion are first introduced under the names Hamring's feeblemind, Hamring's hypnotism, and Hamring's mass hypnosis after Netherese arcanist Hamring.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22, 23, 27

events.text: The Crescent Court, a temple of Sehanine is constructed in Cormanthyr, with the aid of Coronal Miirphys Irithyl.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: The spell hypnotic pattern is first introduced by Netherese arcanist Hamring under the name Hamring's hypnopattern.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 23, 27

events.text: A revolt led by the immortal Chih Shih forces Emperor Tan Chin out of Kuo Meilan. This marks the end of the Second Age of Shou Lung.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Tan Chin escapes to the Raurin, where he starts seeking out lost Imaskari artifacts.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Discovering mithral ore under Mount Waterdeep, a shield dwarf named Melair (later King Melair I) sends word to his fellow dwarves. Those who join him form Clan Melairkyn and create a dwelling for themselves under the mountain.
cites: Skullport, с. 5
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: A military outpost is established in the mountains of southeast Netheril. The outpost is so well defended that it outlasts the fall of the Empire. Though not its official name, (a name which, in Loross, roughly translates to "All-Seeing Master of Lightning,") the soldiers stationed there colloquially refer to the post as "Blister" due to the difficult life they lead.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 66
Dungeon 88: The Door from Everywhere, с. 23

events.text: Qyraaptir the Bloodeye takes command of the entire surface army of the beholder nation and leads them against Calimshan, plunging the Alimir Peninsula into war.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: After centuries of short-lived rulers in Dagger's Point since the death of Lashia the Dagger, one of her original apprentices (kept alive with life-extending magic), Trothas Helgaras establishes firm control and rules in much the same way as his mistress did.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 70

events.text: Unther and Yuireshanyaar war over the southern coast of Aglarond, but the star elves are forced back into the Yuirwood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Unther expands toward the Deep Realms of the Great Rift, triggering conflict with the gold dwarves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Nung Fu, an ordinary peasant, is granted the Emblems of Imperial Authority by the Nine Travelers, becoming the First Emperor of Shou Lung. This marks the Third Age of Shou Lung.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37
Ochimo The Spirit Warrior, с. 3

events.text: The Angardt construct a settlement they call Kismet. They breed, train and trade horses here, but over time, as Kismet is considered more and more holy, it also becomes a site of regular pilgrimage for all Angardt.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 79

events.text: The hostilities between the Angardt and the Netherese city of Thiefsward that have occurred through the Golden Age of Netheril are finally resolved when the Angardt retreat to Kismet.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 90

events.text: The programmed illusion spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Kutson with the name Kutson's programmed illusion.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 23,27

events.text: Over the site of a natural spring, Vaelan is founded, becoming a center of trade.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Following the death of Coronal Vaeqiis, her son Merath becomes coronal and rules Serôs.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: The antipathy/sympathy spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Kutson with the name Kutson's antipathy/sympathy.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 23,27

events.text: Archwizard Requiar, who has been driven mad from wearing the Crown of Horns, is slain in an effort to remove him from control of Shadowtop Borough. The new archwizard in control of the city, Eliam, spends more than 150 years searching for Requiar's lost Crown.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 87

events.text: A mine producing chardalyn is located in the Plain of Standing Stones in Low Netheril.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: Beginning of the Age of Discovery of Netheril.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: On Alturiak 30, Ali yn Enar el Samesaj is born. He will become the Great Vizar of Calimport.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: The Khov'Anilessa or the "Trio Nefarious", three nycaloths, go marauding through Cormanthor, destroying many settlements and elven patrols. According to rumor, Netherese archwizards summoned them to test the elves' magical strength. The three-month-long rampage ends in an enormous battle in Cormanthyr, in which the elves finally subdue the nycaloths. Coronal Miirphys, High Mages, and several priests use Elven High Magic to imprison the nycaloths.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Circa: A secret cabal of Mulhorandi necromancers build the the Mausoleum City of Pholzubbalt, or the Boneyard, beneath Thesk.
A faction of Iulutiuns splits off and migrates east to Angalpuk to become the Angulutiuns.
cites: The Great Glacier, с. 6

events.text: The fortified trading post of Vaelantar is constructed.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: The mind blank spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Kutson with the name Kutson's mind blank.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 23,27

events.text: Lady Decampus — the "Singing Lady" — is killed in a spell-battle by archwizard Delzjhava on the frontier of Netheril.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 110

events.text: The guards and wards spell is invented by Netherese arcanist M'dhal with the name M'dhal's mantle.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 23,27

events.text: The continual light spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Polybeus with the name Polybeus's illumination.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 24,27

events.text: Ali el Samesaj rescues the daughter of a Drakhon sultan of Calimshan from kidnappers. Her grandfather, Syl-Pasha Adjam el Drakhon, rewards him by raising him to the sultan's court, where he becomes the unofficial court wizard.
cites: Calimport, с. 15
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: The levitate spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Yturn with the name Yturn's levitation.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 25,27

events.text: The jump spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Yturn with the name Yturn's long jump.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 25,27

events.text: The feather fall spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Yturn with the name Yturn's feather fall.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 25,27

events.text: The Villaflames conflagration rages in the city of Calimport, destroying a large amount of waterfront properties and royal villas.
cites: Calimport, с. 15

events.text: Court wizard Ali el Samesaj saves the Drakhon sultan from assassination by members of his own court, but much of Hapij Sabban is destroyed in the magical conflict. Rewarded for his loyalty, Ali is named Sultan's Vizar and Druzir of the Seven Sages Drudach.
cites: Calimport, с. 15
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Circa: On the orders of Syl-Pasha Kamal el Drakhon of Calimshan, the Qysanallojal (or Imperial Navy) is constructed to more swiftly transport troops against the beholders of the Alimir Mountains and Lake of Steam. However, with the fleet, Calimshan begins extending its trade, political influence, and military control around the Shining Sea.
cites: Calimport, с. 15
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: The fumble spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Berthot with the name Berthot's blunder.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 23,27

events.text: The archwizard Lady Polaris asks the people of Algid if they would like their town to be turned into a flying enclave. The simple fisherfolk refuse her.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 64

events.text: Orcs attack the Rengarth settlement of Coldfoot. The Rengarth are victorious in the ensuing battle but Coldfoot itself suffers serious damage.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 68

events.text: The blue dragon Lightningdance performs the first of 262 annual surprise attacks on the enclave of Palter.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 83

events.text: The settlement of Frothwater is established at the confluence of several small streams and the Hungry River by several ranchers and homesteaders led by the ranger Samual Frothwater who value hard work and justice over the decadence and control of the enclaves.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 73

events.text: An archaeological dig is established in the valley known as The Hollow when it is discovered that the first Stone Age humans lived there. Unfortunately for the archwizards who funded the construction of the camp—known as Holloway—no ancient magic is ever found.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 76

events.text: A mosque dedicated to the treacherous aspect of Tyche is constructed in the Shade Enclave. The clergy and congregation are all self-centered and vengeful, kept together only by a mutual hatred of Tyche's temple in Imbrue.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 87

events.text: Beholders lay seige to Akkabbel in the Ithal Pass in Calimshan. The garrison receives reinforcements from Calimport via a magical portal cast by the vizar Ali el Samesaj. In the Battle of the Samesaj Gate, the defenders and reinforcements break the siege as the beholders suffer significant losses. The portal remains intact following the battle, known only to Ali to be keyed to the light of the full moon.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: For his efforts, Ali el Samesaj is named Grand Vizar and serves as Syl-Pasha Ruj el Drakhon's side.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: A long-awaited road linking Zazesspur with the garrison at Akkabbel is finally completed after 200 years.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 23
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 17

events.text: The screen spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Berthot with the name Berthot's screen.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 23,27

events.text: Semkhrun is founded in Semphar as an outpost of Mulhorand.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Netherese arcanist M'dhal invents the protection from evil spell under its original name M'dhal's dispel evil.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22–23, 27

events.text: The High Netherese start experiments to travel to other worlds.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: The symbol spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Hersent with the name Hersent's symbol.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 23,27

events.text: Trollflame Wars: After suffering through centuries of troll attacks, the city of Coniferia enters into all-out war with the trolls of the Eastern Forest.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 69

events.text: A dragon attacks the flying enclave of Orbedal. The normally peaceful residents are forced to defend their homes and offensive magic is permitted to be used for the first time in the enclave's history.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 86

events.text: The chaos spell is invented by Netherese arcanist Berthot with the name Berthot's disorder.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 23,27

events.text: Elves slay the last great wyrm dragon of the Wyrmwood, and seize the forest.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: In the Wyrmwood, elves found the kingdom of Arundath, the Quiet Wood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Circa: Coronal Syglaeth Audark of Illefarn orders a Retreat to Evermeet. The empire splits into separate realms: Ardeep, Iliyanbruen (in Neverwinter Wood), and Rilithar (in Westwood and Kryptgarden Forest).
Syglaeth orders that Aelinthaldaar, capital of Illefarn, be razed to the ground with Elven High Magic. Barely a trace remains of the city, even after its 7000-year-long history.
cites: City of Splendors: Waterdeep, с. 6

events.text: Grand Vizar Ali el Samesaj builds his own tomb, Khamamart, the Tomb of Fire, east of Calimport. After raising the fiery marble walls out of ground, Ali enters through one wall and is never seen again.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Coronal Merath of Serôs dies fighting sahuagin raiders.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Lynsal, a wizard, son of Merath, becomes coronal of Serôs.
Regular trade between northern barbarian tribes and the south begins on the site that will eventually become Waterdeep.
cites: City of Splendors (boxed set): Campaign Guide, с. 29
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: Thayd, a Theurgist Adept, leads a group of mages in a rebellion against the empires of Mulhorand and Unther. Thayd claims the northern provinces of both for himself.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: A band of rebellious Mulhorandi wizards open a portal to the orcs' homeworld using Imaskari magic. This eventually results in the Orcgate Wars five years later.
cites: Races of Faerûn, с. 65
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: The rebellious mages of Mulhorand and Unther are defeated and captured.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: The Theurgist Adept Thayd is executed for starting a rebellion in Mulhorand and Unther. He prophesies the decline of both empires.
cites: Unapproachable East, с. 163
Old Empires, с. 5

events.text: Victorious at Mintar, Calimshan wins against the beholders of the Alimir Peninsula.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: Following the war, Calimshan's domain stretches from Mintar to the Sword Coast, gaining greater trade and influence. Calimport almost doubles in size.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: The Orcgate Wars begin when the Orcgate is discovered by the orcs after five years of remaining dormant. Hundreds of thousands of them poured out and engulf northern Mulhorand and Unther. The Mulhorandi enlist Nar, Raumathari, Rashemi, and Sossrim mercenaries to aid them in the battle against the orcs.
cites: Races of Faerûn, с. 65
Old Empires, с. 5
Unapproachable East, с. 163

events.text: The first battle of the Orcgate Wars occurs.
cites: Old Empires, с. 5

events.text: The population of Vandal Station is reduced to a handful of stubborn hangers-on.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 91

events.text: The Battle of the Gods occurs.
cites: Dragons of Faerûn, с. 8
Old Empires, с. 5

events.text: In the Battle of the Gods, Ra is killed by Gruumsh.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39
Old Empires, с. 5

events.text: The Untheric deities Girru, Ki, Inanna, Nanna-Sin, Nergal and Utu are killed by orc deities.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Gilgeam battles Ilneval but is ambushed by Tiamat in a surprise assault. However, Marduk steps in and slays Tiamat before she finish off Gilgeam, but Marduk is killed himself.
cites: Dragons of Faerûn, с. 8
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: The Orcgate Wars end as the orc horde and their gods are finally defeated in the Priador and scattered throughout the region.
cites: Races of Faerûn, с. 65
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Following the war, the Nar, Rashemi, Raumviran, and Sossrim mercenary tribes make their way home.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: The Nars establish a series of small kingdoms over the course of a century. The greatest is Ashanath by Lake Ashane.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Calishite forces continue to expand northward after endless battles with the elves of Tethir. They claim and occupy the ancient dwarven redoubt of Velmhold and renovate it for human-sized habitation. They name it Zazessovertan, meaning "fortress overlooking Zazesspur", and use it as a base to patrol the Trade Way.
cites: Powers & Pantheons, с. 142

events.text: First contact occurs between the Netherese and illithids.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: A portal opens, linking Shandaular, capital of the kingdom of Ashanath, and the Council Hills, far to the south in the Eastern Shaar.
Using the portal, Ashanath expands into the Shaar.
Osiris and Set struggle to succeed Ra and lead the Mulhorandi pantheon. This ends in Set murdering Osiris.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Circa: The Calimshan navy begins assaults on the beholders of the Lake of Steam and drives them underground. These attacks continue until –680 DR.
Circa: Calimshan begins occasional, small trade with Chult and Tashalar.
Osiris is resurrected by Isis.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Horus-Re fights Set and success to lead the Mulhorandi pantheon.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: The end of the First Mulhorand Empire.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: A vein of silver is discovered near Earsome, causing a brief population boom before it is played out within the next 86 years.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 71

events.text: The spell magic circle against evil is invented by Netherese mentalist M'dhal, who calls it M'dhal's dispel evil II.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 22–23, 27, 112

events.text: Emperor Nung Fu of Shou Lung dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Nung Fu's great-grandson is named first Emperor Chin of the Li Dynasty (the Dynasty of Might) of Shou Lung.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: After forging an alliance with the phaerimm to give them captured Netherese arcanists in exchange for information and military aid, Tempest Freion Chagringhost is killed in a raid on his home city of Monikar.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 80

events.text: Thargaun Crell, the future first king of Tharos, which would later become known as Narfell, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 81

events.text: The Marrekh family is ennobled in Netheril. The Waterdhavian noble family of Maerklos descends from this line.
cites: Dragon 213: Series Magic, с. 97

events.text: Oberon, future Netherese arcanist, is born.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 113

events.text: Following several decades of skirmishes and raids against the Nar humans, the elves of Lethyr are forced to abandon the northern Riildath woodlands. They retreat to the south and their more defensible communities there.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Following the withdrawal of the Lethyr elves, Tharos leads the Nars into the Riildath. There, they discover the Ilythiiri ruins of Narathmault and learn the secrets of demon lore. The Nars abandoned their gods in favor of demon worship.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Netherese exploration of other worlds is decided to be dangerous and profitless. They change their focus to exploring their own continent of Faerûn.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Netherese arcanist Hersent develops the spell that would later be known as sepia snake sigil.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 27

events.text: The volcano known as The Hazardous Climb becomes inactive. Although a popular place to go mountaineering, no one ever reaches the 27,000-foot-high (8.2-kilometer-high) summit.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 75
